subject.title: feat(plugins): tool-name matchers scope tool hooks and Codex native hook relay spawns

question: Should exact tool-name matching become a supported public contract across plugin hooks, trusted tool policies, and agent tool-result middleware?
rationale: This changes compatibility-sensitive behavior on three plugin APIs, and maintainers must confirm the permanent alias, empty-list, repeated-registration, and runtime-specific semantics before implementation details can be finalized.

options.title: Approve after contract repairs
options.body: Accept the matcher API after canonical alias handling, per-runtime scope preservation, focused compatibility tests, and live Codex proof are added.

options.title: Keep scoping Codex-internal
options.body: Avoid expanding the public plugin API and pursue an internal Codex relay optimization until broader matcher semantics are designed.

recommendation.title: Approve after contract repairs
recommendation.body: Accept the matcher API after canonical alias handling, per-runtime scope preservation, focused compatibility tests, and live Codex proof are added.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history most directly covers the relay lifecycle and fail-closed behavior affected by this API decision.
